text.arabic_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يُبَشِّرُ ٱللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ ۗ قُل لَّآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا ٱلْمَوَدَّةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ ۗ وَمَن يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةًۭ نَّزِدْ لَهُۥ فِيهَا حُسْنًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ شَكُورٌ

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative pointing back to the prior great bounty while opening the present explanation
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) opens by pointing before explaining: the promised bounty from the prior ayah (42:22) is held up as already identifiable, then the relative clause unfolds how it is announced. The pointer works backward and forward at once, so the verse starts with recognition and expectation rather than with a flat definition.

topics.headline: lifted pointer to bounty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by making the prior bounty a recognized discourse object before explaining it.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on lifted pointer to bounty; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: singular relative pronoun predicating the glad-tiding event of the demonstrative
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) is singular, so it belongs with the opening pointer rather than the later plural servants. It packages the following glad-tiding clause as the definition of what was just pointed to.

topics.headline: singular relative packages the event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word defines the opening pointer through a whole divine action, not through a standalone noun.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on singular relative packages the event; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: active divine glad-tiding in the imperfect, making promised bounty a present communicative act
words.root_gloss_range: range of outward human surface, news that affects the receiver, and glad announcement; locally selected as active glad-tiding
words.prose: {{ar:يُبَشِّرُ}} ({{tr:yubashshiru}}) makes the promised bounty communicative: the imperfect presents glad-tiding as an asserted divine act, and the intensified form makes the news actively delivered to the servants. Accepted variants can modulate that intensity, but the demonstrative frame and servant object keep the act as glad-tiding. Its familiar promise profile is carried into a no-wage setting, so proclamation is separated from commerce from the start. The familiar promise pattern includes a believers-and-deeds glad-tiding scene (2:25), now specialized by the no-wage declaration.

topics.headline: divine glad-tiding made active
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the prior bounty become an active divine announcement that reaches servants before any question of payment appears.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on divine glad-tiding made active; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: nominative proper divine name explicitly naming the agent of glad-tiding
words.root_gloss_range: range associated with worship, devotion, and the proper divine name; locally the unique divine name anchors agency
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) names the subject after the verb, locking the announcement onto God as its source. Against the familiar glad-tidings profile, the divine name itself occupies the herald slot rather than leaving proclamation to messenger charisma or audience desire. The proper name also begins an ayah-level enclosure that returns in the closing attribute seal, so the economics and increase clauses stay inside one divine agency.

topics.headline: explicit divine source of announcement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the divine name itself occupies the glad-tiding agent slot, so the announcement originates in named divine agency rather than messenger charisma or audience desire.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on explicit divine source of announcement; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: His servants as direct recipients, marked by possession before their faith and deeds are named
words.root_gloss_range: range of servanthood, service, obedience, and worship; locally divine belonging frames the recipients
words.prose: {{ar:عِبَادَهُ}} ({{tr:ʿibādahu}}) makes the recipients His servants before the following clause identifies their trust and deeds. That possessive form blocks a customer logic before the no-wage declaration: the group receives good news as those who belong in service and worship, not as buyers of proclamation. Same-surah servant language keeps promise and restraint in view (42:27).

topics.headline: servants defined before deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that relation to God precedes moral performance in the way the recipients are named.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on servants defined before deeds; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: plural relative qualifier that identifies the servants by a two-part profile
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) agrees with the servant group and opens the qualifying clause. It does not let servant identity remain a bare label; it waits for both trust and action to complete the profile.

topics.headline: plural qualifier for the servants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the servants as a defined group whose identity is made legible through trust and restorative action together.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on plural qualifier for the servants; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural verb presenting trust as an accomplished servant qualifier
words.root_gloss_range: range of security, trust, faith, and entrusting; locally selected as the stable trust of the servants
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) presents trust as an accomplished qualifier of the servants. The security-and-trust field makes belief a movement out of insecurity into reliance after the prior fear-and-bounty scene (42:22), and the Form IV shape makes that reliance a committed relation. The matching plural form keeps the same group ready for the coordinated deed that follows.

topics.headline: trust as stable qualifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears trust as an already established move from insecurity into committed reliance before the speech about compensation begins.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on trust as stable qualifier; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction binding belief and deed without making one replace the other
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is small but structurally decisive: it keeps trust and restorative action distinct while binding them into one recipient profile. The qualification is therefore dual without becoming divided.

topics.headline: belief and deed held together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that action stands beside trust as a co-qualifier, not as a later optional add-on.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on belief and deed held together; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural action directed toward an explicit restorative-deed object
words.root_gloss_range: range of performed work, practice, and carried-out effort; locally outward enactment of trust
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) turns the servant profile outward into performed action, and the following object specifies the kind of work meant. The paired perfect form keeps the same believers as the actors, while the no-wage section later prevents this work from being monetized by the messenger. The trust-and-action pairing also resonates with the loss-averting profile (103:3).

topics.headline: trust carried into action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the servants are not described by inward trust alone; their profile moves into performed repair.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on trust carried into action; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: recognized class of restorative deeds functioning as the object of performed action
words.root_gloss_range: range of soundness, repair, reconciliation, fitness, and setting right; locally the deed-class performed by believers
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) completes the action as a definite class of restorative deeds. Its repair field prepares the later good-beauty chain: the ayah moves from known acts of setting right to any good deed receiving added beauty. The known righteous-deeds formula appears in promise contexts such as 2:25, but here it prepares the later internal increase.

topics.headline: righteous deeds as repair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action is completed by a known class of deeds that restore and set right, not by generic activity.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on righteous deeds as repair; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: second-person imperative shifting divine narration into mandated public speech
words.root_gloss_range: range of saying, speech, and utterance; locally commanded disclosure
words.prose: {{ar:قُل}} ({{tr:qul}}) cuts from divine glad-tiding into mandated speech. The messenger is ordered to voice the refusal of compensation, so economic transparency becomes part of the proclamation itself. The no-wage speech formula recalls earlier prophetic refrains (26:109).

topics.headline: public no-wage utterance commanded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the no-wage claim as a commanded public performance, not as an optional aside.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on public no-wage utterance commanded; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: negation particle scoping over the messenger’s asking before the exception resolves the clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَّآ}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the act of asking and opens a structure that will not settle until the exception appears. The listener first hears ordinary compensation blocked before any relational remainder is named.

topics.headline: negation opens the no-wage frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial targets solicitation from the audience, not divine reward itself.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on negation opens the no-wage frame; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: first-person request verb with audience object, narrowed by the wage object to solicitation rather than inquiry
words.root_gloss_range: range of asking, questioning, requesting, and demanding; locally selected as solicitation refused by the speaker
words.prose: {{ar:أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ}} ({{tr:asʾalukum}}) contains the speaker and the addressed audience in one compact verb. Because the object is a wage, the broad asking field narrows to solicitation: the commanded speaker refuses to make a demand on the audience’s resources. The no-wage formula recalls earlier messenger speech (26:109), while this ayah gives it a distinct relational exception.

topics.headline: direct request denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees compensation denied as a direct speaker-audience demand, not as an abstract anti-payment slogan.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on direct request denied; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: prepositional phrase marking the basis on which a fee would have been charged
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhi}}) marks what the fee would be for, whether the referent is the announcement, message, or mission. Its placement between asking and wage makes the chargeable basis audible before the fee noun arrives.

topics.headline: basis of the denied fee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied payment is tied to the message or mission itself, not to a vague personal favor.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on basis of the denied fee; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: indefinite wage or reward noun under negation, excluding human compensation while leaving divine recompense to be redefined later
words.root_gloss_range: range of wage, payment, recompense, and reward; locally human fee is denied while divine return remains distinct
words.prose: {{ar:أَجْرًا}} ({{tr:ajran}}) names the payment category being refused. Its indefiniteness under negation broadens the exclusion, while the later increase and appreciative closure reassign true recompense to God rather than to audience payment. The forward movement toward divine recompense remains visible later in the surah (42:40).

topics.headline: transactional return displaced
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees ordinary compensation named and excluded before the ayah pivots to affection and then divine increase.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on transactional return displaced; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: exception particle pivoting from denied wage to the relational remainder
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) turns a flat denial into a test of what remains after money is excluded. The grammar can be heard as a connected or disconnected exception, and that live ambiguity protects both obligation and non-commercial proclamation.

topics.headline: exception keeps relation non-commercial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that affection is introduced through an exception that can demand relation without simply turning love into a fee.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on exception keeps relation non-commercial; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: definite affection or loyal love as the named exception within the sphere of nearness
words.root_gloss_range: range of love, desire, goodwill, and steady attachment; locally durable relational loyalty rather than passing sentiment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَوَدَّةَ}} ({{tr:al-mawaddata}}) is the charged relational noun in the exception. The standard definite verbal noun makes affection a recognized demand; the reported indefinite variant would soften that specificity, so the local reading keeps the exception pointed and known. Its root field points to durable goodwill and attachment rather than a passing feeling, and the following prepositional phrase constrains where that affection is practiced. A relational-love setting such as 30:21 clarifies that this noun can mark durable bond, while this ayah relocates that force into mission-response.

topics.headline: durable affection as exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the non-wage remainder is definite, directed affection within relation, not vague warmth or substitute cash.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on durable affection as exception; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: preposition locating affection within the domain or circumstance of nearness
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) governs the nearness phrase as a sphere, domain, or circumstance. The ayah does not simply name a direct object to love; it frames affection as something practiced within relational proximity.

topics.headline: affection placed in a sphere
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids reducing the phrase to a simple direct object of love; the affection is located within a relational field.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on affection placed in a sphere; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: definite unsuffixed nearness as a relational field, spanning kinship and proximity without naming a possessor or listing persons
words.root_gloss_range: range of approaching, being near, kinship, proximity, rank, and devotional nearness; locally an open relational domain
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-qurbā}}) closes the exception phrase with definite but unsuffixed nearness. Because no possessor is named and the form names an abstract domain rather than a plural list of persons, the word holds together kinship, proximity, and maintained relation; affection after wage denial becomes repaired nearness rather than an itemized fee. Ethical near-relation passages such as 2:177 and 16:90 stand behind the range, while 42:17 keeps nearness active within the surah.

topics.headline: nearness left relationally open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase keeps kinship and proximity open enough to require interpretation rather than listing a simple beneficiary.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on nearness left relationally open; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction moving from the no-wage exception into the conditional increase rule
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) restarts the discourse after the nearness phrase and attaches the conditional rule to the no-wage economy. It moves the ayah from addressed audience to any moral agent without making the condition part of the quoted fee denial.

topics.headline: transition to universal rule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah widen from addressed speech to a general rule of divine increase.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on transition to universal rule; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: conditional whoever governing acquisition and increase as a universal rule
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) opens the conditional grammar: acquisition and increase become mutually tied parts of a rule. After the second-person address, the word creates an open human variable for anyone who enters the pattern.

topics.headline: whoever opens the rule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the promise broaden beyond the immediate addressees to any person who acquires a good deed.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on whoever opens the rule; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: jussive Form VIII acquisition of a good deed, with contact or commission imagery turned toward positive moral gain
words.root_gloss_range: range of scraping, contact, acquiring, taking on, and commission; locally the rare acquisition field is reversed toward good
words.prose: {{ar:يَقْتَرِفْ}} ({{tr:yaqtarif}}) is jussive under the conditional and forms the trigger for increase. Its root field can carry rough contact or commission pressure, but the good-deed object reverses that texture toward positive acquisition; the actor takes on a moral trace that will be beautified. The contrast with acquisition elsewhere (6:113) makes the positive object here conspicuous.

topics.headline: rough acquisition turned toward good
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the marked verb choice: a contact-colored acquisition word is used for taking on a good deed.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on rough acquisition turned toward good; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: one unspecified good deed as the object that activates internal increase
words.root_gloss_range: range of moral good, beauty, excellence, and pleasing quality; locally a single good act eligible for added quality
words.prose: {{ar:حَسَنَةًۭ}} ({{tr:ḥasanatan}}) turns the rare acquisition verb toward good. Its indefinite singular form lowers the threshold, and its shared field with the later added quality makes recompense an intensification of the deed’s own goodness-beauty rather than an unrelated payment. Multiplication passages such as 4:40 and 6:160 clarify the recompense field, while this ayah stresses added quality within the deed.

topics.headline: one good deed becomes enough
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that even one unspecified good deed can become the site of divine increase.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on one good deed becomes enough; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: first-person divine jussive response adding surplus to the acquired good
words.root_gloss_range: range of adding, growing, increasing, and exceeding a base measure; locally divine surplus beyond exchange
words.prose: {{ar:نَّزِدْ}} ({{tr:nazid}}) answers the conditional as the divine apodosis. The standard first-person form makes the increase visibly divine, while agency variants show how much the local reading foregrounds the source of increase. The increase root exceeds equivalence; after human wage is denied, this verb supplies the ayah’s alternative economy. The increase thread links gratitude and surplus in 14:7 and appears again in the same surah (42:26).

topics.headline: increase as alternative economy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the answer to good is surplus increase, not balanced invoice or human fee.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on increase as alternative economy; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: benefactive phrase assigning the increase to the person while the next phrase locates it inside the deed
words.prose: {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) marks the beneficiary of the increase and resumes the open conditional person as a singular recipient. Its position before the internal-locus phrase keeps benefit and transformation distinct: for him, but within it.

topics.headline: beneficiary separated from locus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the person benefits, while the deed itself remains the place where added beauty is located.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on beneficiary separated from locus; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: preposition with feminine suffix locating the increase inside the good deed just mentioned
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) most naturally points back to the feminine good deed and locates the increase inside it. The phrase appears before the added quality, so the reader first hears where the beautification happens: within the deed’s reality.

topics.headline: increase placed inside the deed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the added beauty happens within the good deed, not merely beside the doer as external compensation.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on increase placed inside the deed; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: indefinite added goodness-beauty as the quality increased within the deed
words.root_gloss_range: range of moral good, beauty, excellence, and pleasing quality; locally the added qualitative refinement of a good deed
words.prose: {{ar:حُسْنًا}} ({{tr:ḥusnan}}) names what is added: goodness-beauty itself. The standard indefinite form leaves the added quality open in kind and degree; variant shapes would push the hearing toward phonetic color or a more fixed best-outcome sense, so the local form keeps the increase open-ended. The root echo with the acquired good deed makes recompense internally reflexive and qualitative. The relation between best outcome and increase in 10:26 is compressed here into added quality within the deed.

topics.headline: good answered by added beauty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees reward as qualitative beautification of the deed’s own field, not merely a separate payout.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on good answered by added beauty; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle introducing the divine-name clause that warrants the increase rule
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) launches the closing warrant. After the conditional promise of internal increase, the emphatic particle grounds the rule in stable divine character and prepares the paired predicates that explain it.

topics.headline: attribute seal introduced as reason
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing attributes as an explanation for the surprising increase rule, not as a loose devotional ending.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on attribute seal introduced as reason; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: accusative proper divine name as the emphasized subject of the closing attribute seal
words.root_gloss_range: range associated with worship, devotion, and the proper divine name; locally the same divine identity grounds the closing attributes
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) is the accusative subject after the emphatic particle, anchoring the final attributes in the same divine name that opened the announcement. The repetition encloses the no-wage speech and conditional promise inside one divine agency. The recompense-and-increase formula with the same attribute pair appears in 35:30.

topics.headline: same God grounds the seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the one who announced the glad tidings is the same named subject whose attributes warrant increase.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on same God grounds the seal; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: first intensive predicate, abundant covering and forgiveness that protects good from being erased by deficiency
words.root_gloss_range: range of covering, shielding, protecting, and forgiving; locally abundant fault-covering in the attribute seal
words.prose: {{ar:غَفُورٌۭ}} ({{tr:ghafūrun}}) is the first predicate of the closing seal. Its covering-and-forgiveness field shields human deficiency, and the intensive pattern makes that covering abundant; placed before the appreciative predicate, it clears the field for good to be recognized and increased. The same attribute pair follows recompense and increase in 35:30.

topics.headline: covering clears the field for increase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine response begins with covering fault before appreciative magnification is named.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on covering clears the field for increase; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

words.gloss_range: second intensive predicate, divine appreciative recognition that magnifies good
words.root_gloss_range: range of acknowledging benefit, thanking, appreciating, and responding with recognition; locally divine generous appreciation, not needful thanks
words.prose: {{ar:شَكُورٌ}} ({{tr:shakūrun}}) completes the attribute pair and the ayah lands on appreciative divine response. Applied to God, the root means generous recognition rather than needful thanks, and the intensive form makes that recognition abundant and responsive. The final word explains why one good deed receives increased beauty. Human gratitude and divine increase meet in 14:7, while 35:30 pairs increase with the appreciative attribute.

topics.headline: final landing on divine appreciation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader leaves the ayah hearing reward as God’s appreciative recognition of good, not as the messenger’s wage.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on final landing on divine appreciation; local grammar and reference constraints preserve the payoff without requiring a broader unlicensed reading.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated request for ajr and the exception of mawadda within al-qurba.
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance cancels a work-for-wage claim and substitutes love maintained inside nearness. The focus inventory keeps both lived proximity and kin relation active, so the exception changes the medium of return from a payable object to a relationship.

activation_trace.role: The request branch supplies the solicitation that the explicit negation cancels.
The work-compensation branch supplies the rejected commercial measure of return.
The love branch supplies the positive relational medium placed after the exception.
The nearness branch makes proximity itself the sphere in which affection operates.
The kinship branch keeps concrete relations of descent available without exhausting the broader proximity image.

changed_reading.before: The speaker declines payment but asks for affection toward relatives.
changed_reading.after: The declaration converts recompense from a commodity into maintained relational nearness, with kinship and produced proximity remaining coexisting scopes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Whoever yaqtarif a hasana is increased, within it, in husn.
baseline_models.mechanism: The acquired good is not merely entered in an external ledger: it adheres to the doer, and the prepositional phrase places the increase inside that good. The movement from a discrete hasana to intensified husn makes one act a carrier whose quality expands.

activation_trace.role: The acquisition-that-clothes branch makes the gained act adhere to and characterize its doer.
The doing-good branch links the initial good unit and its expanded qualitative outcome.
The growth branch supplies the internal enlargement rather than a merely separate prize.

changed_reading.before: A good deed receives an additional reward.
changed_reading.after: A good act adheres to the agent and becomes an internally growing site in which a discrete good is intensified into fuller goodness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The increase in goodness closes with God as ghafur and shakur.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two closing qualities produce an asymmetry: damaging residue is covered and its bearer protected, while even a slight positive input is made visibly effective. Increase therefore belongs to a mercy-weighted evaluation rather than strict equivalence.

activation_trace.role: The protective covering of fault supplies attenuation on the negative side.
The small input whose effect becomes manifest supplies amplification on the positive side.
The growth branch turns that positive responsiveness into the stated operation of increase.

changed_reading.before: Forgiving and grateful are two reassuring divine attributes.
changed_reading.after: The close defines an asymmetric evaluation: failure is covered, while slight goodness is amplified until its effect appears.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated revelation frames the discourse as received knowledge, while the later restriction to conveyance denies the messenger custodial control. Because God is the subject of the good news and the messenger is commanded to say the no-wage clause, the disclaimer marks the message as an entrusted transmission rather than the speaker's monetizable property.

activation_trace.role: The spoken-command branch marks the human utterance as an explicitly commissioned saying.
The compensation branch identifies the ownership claim that is refused.
The divinely given report supplies the upstream source of the surah's speech.
The messenger-and-message branch defines the speaker as a sent carrier.
The guarding branch is explicitly negated as a form of coercive custody over the audience.
The delivery branch supplies the positively retained limit of the messenger's task.

structural_cues: The surah opens with revelation language and closes by returning to modes of divine communication.
In the focus, divine agency in giving good news is followed by the imperative to the messenger to speak.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revelation, sending, denied guardianship, and restricted delivery; I infer that the no-fee statement follows this role architecture; a live alternative is that it is only a personal ascetic disclaimer.

changed_reading.before: The messenger personally waives a fee for his preaching.
changed_reading.after: The messenger cannot price or possess an entrusted divine communication; his role is voiced delivery without custodial control, and the relational exception is not a sale price.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly stages a movement from religious fragmentation and rivalry in the space between people toward divine gathering. Within that field, mawadda in nearness reads as an anti-fragmentation practice that maintains a connection across the very interval where rivalry opened a gap.

activation_trace.role: The love branch supplies the adhesive social force.
The proximity branch supplies the relation that affection is to preserve or produce.
The scattering branch supplies the explicitly prohibited social-religious counterforce.
The connection-between-parties branch identifies the relational interval damaged by rivalry.
The gathering-of-the-scattered branch supplies the opposed movement toward restored togetherness.

structural_cues: The command not to divide in 42:13 is followed by division caused by rivalry between people in 42:14.
The speaker's declaration in 42:15 ends with God gathering between the parties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies scattering, a damaged between-space, gathering, love, and nearness; I infer that affection functions against fragmentation; a live alternative is that the focus exception concerns only a bounded kinship duty.

changed_reading.before: Mawadda is an affection owed within a preexisting near relation.
changed_reading.after: Mawadda becomes a counter-movement to fragmentation: it maintains or rebuilds nearness across a rivalry-damaged relational space.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah ends by naming a great surplus after locating believers in expansive garden spaces. Its demonstrative is then repeated at the focus opening. This resolves the focus's initially sealed 'that' backward: the good news is anchored first in the preceding bounty, and the focus then unfolds the noncommercial and amplifying economy of that bounty.

activation_trace.role: The joy-opening report branch supplies the announcement whose deictic content needs resolution.
The spacious-place branch supplies the expansive setting of the announced state.
The surplus branch supplies the immediately named content picked up by the repeated demonstrative.

structural_cues: 42:22 closes with a demonstrative naming the great surplus, and 42:23 opens with the same demonstrative construction.
The focus's relative clause presents the picked-up content as what God announces to believing doers of good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent repeated demonstratives, gardens, and surplus; I infer backward deictic pickup; a live alternative is that the focus demonstrative points more broadly to the whole promise or forward to its own clauses.

changed_reading.before: The opening demonstrative vaguely introduces the promise stated in the focus ayah.
changed_reading.after: The focus first picks up the preceding great bounty in the gardens, then explains its relational, noncommercial, and amplifying logic.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier harvest sequence gives the focus's internal increase a material mechanism: an intended harvest begins with cultivation and is increased in its own field. The later reprise joins the same believers and good works to response and surplus, so a hasana behaves like seed whose return grows within it and exceeds equivalence.

activation_trace.role: The acquired-and-worn branch makes the good an invested possession that remains with the doer.
The good-doing branch supplies both the planted unit and its qualitative yield.
The slight provision with a manifest effect supplies the disproportionate responsiveness of the yield.
The sowing-and-cultivation branch supplies the material analogy for an act that produces a later harvest.
The repeated growth branch directly parallels increase occurring within the intended harvest.
The answering branch makes increase a responsive relation rather than an automatic exchange rate.
The second repeated growth branch confirms the focus operation on the same believing doers of good.
The surplus branch names the excess beyond proportional return.

structural_cues: 42:20 and 42:23 share the sequence 'We increase for him in', first with harvest and then with the acquired good.
42:26 repeats believers, good works, increase, and surplus immediately after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cultivation, two exact increase patterns, response, and surplus; I infer a seed-to-yield mechanism for hasana; a live alternative is that the agricultural language offers only rhetorical parallelism.

changed_reading.before: God adds a reward to a completed good deed.
changed_reading.after: The deed is cultivated like seed: response acts within it, turning its own quality into a surplus yield rather than paying a fixed external amount.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes sheer expansion from beneficial increase: unrestricted provision can produce transgression, so provision is apportioned by discerning measure. The focus's increase 'in it, in goodness' is therefore qualitative and pedagogical, not a promise of indiscriminate material enlargement.

activation_trace.role: The increase branch supplies the operation whose kind is constrained by the context.
The good-versus-ugly branch identifies improvement in quality as the stated direction of increase.
The expansion-and-abundance branch supplies the material kind of increase that can be granted or withheld.
The constriction-to-a-limited-measure branch supplies the counteroperation to expansion.
The fine and hidden precision branch makes provision a subtle calibration rather than raw quantity.
The abundance branch supplies the hypothetical excess explicitly linked to transgression.
The apportioned-gift branch identifies what is being regulated for the servants.
The discerning-measure branch supplies purposeful calibration after the warning about excess.

structural_cues: The focus specifies increase within the good and toward goodness, rather than naming material provision.
42:27 gives an explicit causal reason why unbounded expansion would not be beneficent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expansion, constriction, subtle precision, apportioned provision, and the transgression counterfactual; I infer that focus increase is calibrated formation; a live alternative is that spiritual and material increases remain independent topics.

changed_reading.before: Increase is an unrestricted enlargement of the reward for good.
changed_reading.after: Increase is measured care that deepens the goodness of the act and agent; more quantity can be withheld when it would deform them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence makes the focus's asymmetry explicit and social. Harm returns through what hands acquire, yet much is erased; believers deliberate and spend; equivalent redress is permitted, but pardon plus repair transfers the wage claim to God. The messenger takes no wage from people, while God underwrites relational repair and asks the community to reproduce forgiving restraint.

activation_trace.role: The acquisition that clothes its doer anchors the focus side of moral consequence.
The protective covering of fault anchors the focus's negative-side attenuation.
The visible effect of a slight input anchors the focus's positive-side amplification.
The acquired gain branch supplies the hand-made causal return of harmful action.
The relinquishing-punishment branch interrupts that causal return for much of what was acquired.
The extraction of judgment through mutual review turns relational care into shared deliberation.
The outgoing expenditure branch turns relational care into material circulation.
The relinquishing-punishment branch supplies a chosen departure from exact retaliation.
The reconciliation branch makes pardon constructive repair rather than passive surrender.
The compensation branch relocates payment for repair from the human audience to God.
The heart-abiding love branch, negated for wrongdoers, sets a justice boundary on relational affection.
The human act of protective forgiveness mirrors the focus's divine closing quality.

structural_cues: 42:30 pairs acquired harm with pardoning much, while the focus pairs acquired good with increase.
42:39-43 moves from justified defense through equivalence to pardon, repair, patience, and forgiveness.
The no-wage statement in the focus is answered by 42:40 placing the repairer's wage upon God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquired consequence, extensive pardon, consultation, spending, bounded redress, repair, transferred wage, and human forgiveness; I infer a community enactment of the focus's divine asymmetry; a live alternative is that these are adjacent ethical rulings without a shared economy.

changed_reading.before: God privately forgives faults and rewards good deeds, while mawadda is mainly an inward feeling.
changed_reading.after: The mercy-weighted evaluation becomes a social practice: deliberate together, circulate provision, restrain retaliation, repair relations, and leave the resulting wage claim with God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later family language places kin relations between possible loss and unearned divine giving. This activates the kinship branch of al-qurba but removes entitlement: affection is care within a contingent gift, not a payment that purchases privilege or guarantees that a family remains gathered.

activation_trace.role: The love branch supplies the demanded quality of the near relation.
The kinship branch supplies the concrete family scope activated by the later sequence.
The rejected compensation branch prevents kin affection from functioning as a purchase.
The belonging-and-near-group branch supplies a family relation that can nevertheless be lost.
The gift-without-return branch frames children and their resulting relations as unpriced bestowal.
The pairing branch supplies the contingent formation of family configurations.

structural_cues: 42:45 describes loss of self and family rather than automatic salvation through belonging.
42:49-50 varies gifted children, pairing, and childlessness under divine giving and measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies kin belonging, possible family loss, gift without return, and varied pairing; I infer that kinship is a non-entitling arena of mawadda; a live alternative is that al-qurba refers primarily to proximity rather than family.

changed_reading.before: Affection toward kin is the one compensatory claim made on the audience.
changed_reading.after: Kinship is one contingent, divinely gifted arena in which noncommercial affection must be practiced; it neither buys the message nor guarantees salvific privilege.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of the focus request root to a gentle or hidden drawing-out image. It remains anchored to word 12 and coheres with the no-wage and conveyance clauses, but downstream prose must label it a split-root resonance, not a morphological translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated asking in la asalukum.

activation_trace.role: The gentle hidden extraction branch recasts the negated request as refusal to draw value out of the audience.
The compensation branch identifies what would otherwise be extracted.
The love branch prevents the exception from becoming another covert commodity.
The delivery branch supports a non-extractive messenger role limited to getting the message across.

changed_reading.before: The speaker does not ask for payment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the speaker also refuses subtle extraction from the audience; affection must remain genuinely relational rather than a concealed fee.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the packet's secondary mapping of the increase root to carrying provisions. It remains anchored to the focus increase and gains a visible path mechanism from the surah's close, but downstream prose should present it as a travel-provision resonance, not replace the ordinary sense of growth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The promise nazid lahu fiha husna.

activation_trace.role: The carried-provision branch lets increased goodness function as supply for an onward passage.
The enacted-good branch identifies what becomes portable provision.
The gentle direction-to-a-path branch supplies movement requiring guidance.
The straight-road branch supplies the route for which goodness can serve as provision.

changed_reading.before: God increases the amount or quality of a good deed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the increase also provisions the doer with goodness for the guided road on which the surah finally places the message.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The material fracture-setting branch of ajr is surprising and should not displace its ordinary compensation sense. It remains anchored because the focus joins ajr to affection and nearness, while 42:40 directly joins pardon, repair, and ajr; downstream prose should mark the splint image as a material analogy for relational repair.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rejected ajr immediately followed by affection in nearness.

activation_trace.role: The setting of a fracture supplies a material image for recompense as repaired alignment.
The love branch supplies the binding force of the proposed relational repair.
The nearness branch supplies the restored alignment sought by the repair.
The relinquishing-punishment branch removes pressure that would keep the relational fracture open.
The reconciliation branch explicitly supplies repair between estranged parties.
The repeated fracture-setting branch links repaired relation to a wage borne by God.

changed_reading.before: The messenger refuses a wage and asks instead for affection.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the only fitting 'ajr' is the splinting of broken nearness through affection, while God assumes the actual compensation for pardon and repair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading crosses domains from joyful report to skin surface and then to the later noun 'human', so it is deliberately surprising. It remains anchored in the focus good-news root and in 42:51's same-root human recipient plus concealed communication, but prose must qualify it as a branch-image convergence rather than lexical identity.

activation_trace.role: The appearing surface branch lets the announced future become perceptible at the recipient's exterior.
The joy-opening report branch supplies the affective event that changes that surface.
The visible-skinned human branch identifies the embodied recipient of mediated divine speech.
The hidden imparting of knowledge supplies what crosses into human reception without direct possession.
The screening barrier supplies the concealed boundary across which the communication is mediated.

changed_reading.before: God reports a joyful future to His servants.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, hidden divine communication crosses a barrier and makes its promised future appear on the human surface as present joy.

strongest_changes: The repeated demonstrative resolves the good news backward to the great surplus and garden-state of 42:22.
The harvest and repeated-increase sequence turns hasana into seed whose goodness grows internally and responsively.
Measured provision prevents increase from being reduced to unrestricted material quantity.
Acquired harm is often erased while acquired good is amplified, and that divine asymmetry becomes communal pardon and repair.
The revelation and conveyance frame makes the no-wage clause a statement about entrusted message custody, not only personal renunciation.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet supplied an unusually tight chain of repeated wording: great surplus to 'that which He announces', harvest-increase to good-increase to surplus-increase, no human wage to a repairer's wage upon God, and divine forgiveness to human forgiveness. Split mappings also exposed contained extraction, splint, provision, and surface-mediated readings that a conservative synthesis would likely suppress.
remaining_uncertainties: The backward reach of the opening demonstrative may be exclusive to 42:22 or may gather a broader promise.
Al-qurba can privilege kinship, lived proximity, or both; the packet supports coexistence but not final disambiguation.
The grammatical force of the exception can still affect whether mawadda is heard as requested return, sole residual claim, or description of the noncommercial relation.
The split-root and material-branch outliers are traceable activations but should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The requested return is affection operating inside nearness.** Lexical evidence: و د د `B001` (affectionate attachment), ق ر ب `B003` (kinship) and `B004` (privileged nearness), and ء ج ر `B001` (recompense for work). Structural cue and role: ordinary payment is denied, then **ٱلْمَوَدَّةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ** occupies the exception-slot. Abductive move: I infer that the exception reframes recompense from a transferable wage into maintenance of close relation; the construction leaves kinship and nearness readings co-present. Reading change: the response requested for proclamation is relational attachment, not purchase of the message.

2. **A good act is acquired as something that clings, then grows in quality.** Lexical evidence: ق ر ف `B003` (acquiring what clings), ح س ن `B001` (goodness/beauty) and `B002` (beneficent action), ز ي د `B001` (increase), and ش ك ر `B002` (little sustains and shows its effect). Structural cue and role: **يَقْتَرِفْ** gives the act adhesive persistence, while **نَّزِدْ ... فِيهَا حُسْنًا** increases goodness within it. Abductive move: I infer that divine appreciative response develops the act's internal quality rather than merely adding an external reward. Reading change: goodness is a retained, cultivable acquisition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:49–50 made **ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ** newly reproductive: affection in nearness now sits beside the sovereign giving, pairing, or withholding of offspring, without reducing nearness to biology alone.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A relation replaces a wage transaction.** **Lexical evidence:** ء ج ر `B001` (recompense for work), negated in أَجْرًا; و د د `B001` (affection and loving attachment); and ق ر ب `B003` (kinship and blood relation), anchored in ٱلْمَوَدَّةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ. **Structural cue:** the construction explicitly displaces requested payment with attachment in nearness, while 42:22 had located bounty "at their Lord" and 42:25-26 speak of servants, response, and added favor. **Assigned role:** the negated wage blocks exchange logic; affection and nearness supply a durable social bond. **Abductive move:** I infer that the requested outcome of proclamation is relational maintenance rather than compensation. **Reading change:** the clause establishes a non-commercial message economy rather than naming an unusual fee.
2. **A good act is acquired as something that clings, then grows.** **Lexical evidence:** ق ر ف `B003` (acquiring what then clings to a person), ح س ن `B001` (goodness or beauty), and ز ي د `B001` (increase and growth), anchored in يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدْ ... حُسْنًا. **Structural cue:** 42:20 used cultivation and increase; here acquisition, increase, and intensified goodness form a compact sequence. **Assigned role:** acquisition attaches the act to its doer, and increase develops its quality beyond the initiating act. **Abductive move:** I infer a compounding process rather than a one-for-one payment. **Reading change:** good is not simply credited; it adheres and becomes more good.
3. **Divine thanks as making a little provision visibly thrive.** **Lexical evidence:** ش ك ر `B002` (being sustained by little and showing its effect), anchored in شَكُورٌ. **Structural cue:** a single acquired good is increased; 42:27 will describe measured provision, and 42:28 rain and spreading mercy after despair. **Assigned role:** the branch explains how a small input becomes a visible enlarged effect under limited provision. **Abductive move:** I infer a growth analogy linking thanks, measured provision, and rain; the title itself does not state the material process. **Reading change:** شَكُورٌ becomes the one who makes small good flourish, not only the one who acknowledges it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:27's measured provision and 42:28's rain after despair made ش ك ر `B002` the strongest later surprise: small input visibly thrives under limited supply. The same later pair changed divine thanks from acknowledgment into growth-enabling care.

baseline.text: Allah'ın, inanıp iyi işler yapan kullarına müjdelediği şey budur. De ki: Bunun karşılığında sizden bir ücret istemiyorum; yalnızca yakınlığa sevgi istiyorum. Kim bir iyilik kazanırsa onun güzelliğini artırırız. Allah bağışlayandır, iyiliğin karşılığını verendir.

findings.text: İstenen karşılık, aktarılabilir bir ücret değil, yakınlık içinde işleyen ve ilişkiyi sürdüren sevgi bağıdır.
İyi eylem sahibine yapışan bir kazanım olur; ilahi karşılık yalnızca dış ödül eklemek yerine onun içindeki iyiliği büyütür.
Allah'ın iyiliğe karşılık vermesi, az bir iyiliğin sınırlı imkân içinde beslenip görünür biçimde gelişmesini sağlayan büyütücü bir karşılık olarak da belirir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Desired outcomes arise through planting and tending, then return as yield, gain, or allotted share.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Moral and eschatological acquisition is expanded into a concrete field economy of sowing, watering, land repair, harvesting, and account allocation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Posting the Yield to an Account
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Work produces an acquisition that adheres to its actor and is divided into wages, shares, surplus, and provision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: labor and earning `quranic:root_000303:B001/m01`; acquired outcome `quranic:root_001296:B001/m01`; an acquired act clinging to its doer `quranic:root_001220:B003/m01`; wage or reward `quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`; allotted share `quranic:root_001507:B005/m01`; surplus or bounty `quranic:root_001163:B001/m01`; apportioned provision `quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The field's yield becomes an account: what one works for adheres as personal acquisition, then appears as a specified wage or share. Increase and bounty remain apportioned rather than ownerless abundance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Return becomes effective through response and acceptance, followed by removal of the old trace and renewed increase.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Forgiveness is materialized as footprints erased by wind and covering lifted or replaced, after which growth resumes.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Erasing the Old Track and Regrowing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The prior offense is covered and its track erased, allowing growth to begin after what was left behind.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: pardon as erasure `quranic:root_001032:B001/m01`; wind erasing a footprint `quranic:root_001032:B006/m01`; protective covering of guilt `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`; covering or removing an offense `quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`; growth after leaving something behind `quranic:root_001032:B007/m01`; renewed increase `quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Pardon changes the terrain: the incriminating track is covered until it can no longer guide pursuit. The same lexical field then turns from disappearance to fresh growth, linking forgiveness with renewed capacity.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insan derisinin görünen dış bölümünü doğrudan verir; toprakla kurulan yapılarda ise toprağın üzerinde beliren bitkiyi aynı görünürlük bağıyla buna ekler. branches.source_phrase_ar: وسمى البشر بشرا لظهورهم (maqayis)؛ البشر الإنسان الواحد رجلا كان أو امرأة (ayn)؛ البشر اسم يقع على الناس (jamhara)؛ البشر الخلق (sihah;tahdhib)؛ عبر عن الإنسان بالبشر اعتبارا بظهور جلده (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki yapı türünü açıkça birlikte verir: kadınla tenlerin değdiği doğrudan bedensel temas ve bir işin başında bizzat bulunup onu kendisinin yürütmesi. Ortak nokta aracısız ve kişisel katılımdır; iki yapı kendi sınırları içinde ayrı tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kadınla ilgili kullanım doğrudan bedensel teması, işle ilgili kullanım ise kişisel hazır bulunuş ve yürütmeyi gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca kadınla doğrudan bedensel temas ve bir işi bizzat üstlenme yapılarında belirlenir; çıplak köke genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapılarda, iki kişinin tenlerinin değmesi yoluyla doğrudan bedensel yakınlaşmayı anlatır. Bir iş söz konusu olduğunda ise o işin başında bizzat bulunup onu kendisi yürütmeyi belirtir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi, aracı olmadan kendi bedeniyle ya da şahsen doğrudan katılır.
Kadınla ilgili yapılarda tenlerin değdiği yakın veya cinsel teması anlatır.
İşle ilgili yapıda, kişinin işin başında bulunmasını ve onu kendisinin yürütmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bedensel kullanımda tenlerin doğrudan değmesini; işle ilgili kullanımda ise kişinin hazır bulunup işi bizzat yürütmesini aynı aracısız katılım çevresinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: doğrudan temas etme veya işi bizzat yürütme
concept_gloss.applicability: Kadınla ten teması ve işle kişisel ilgilenme yapılarını, ortak aracısız katılım sınırıyla birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel temas ile işi şahsen yürütme arasındaki yapı ayrımını ve doğrudanlığı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadınla doğrudan ten teması veya cinsel yakınlaşma anlatılan yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tenlerin doğrudan değmesiyle gerçekleşen bedensel yakınlığı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin işin başında bulunup işi aracı kullanmadan kendisinin yürüttüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişisel hazır bulunuşu ve işin doğrudan üstlenilmesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir erkeğin bir kadınla ten tene yakınlaşması
işin başında bizzat bulunup onu yürütme

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kadınla tenlerin gerçekten değmesini ve ayrıca bir işi bizzat yürütmeyi içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaklaşma, bir şeye karışma ve suçla ilişki kurma gibi daha geniş temas derecelerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kadınla cinsel yakınlık ve kişilerin birbirine yaklaşması alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bedensel kullanımda gerçek ten temasını şart koşar ve işle ilgili ayrı bir yapı taşır; komşu dal yaklaşma ve karışmaya kadar genişler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Doğrudan ten temasını veya bir işi şahsen yürütmeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeye yaklaşmayı, eşiğine gelmeyi veya cinsel ilişkiyi dolaylı anlatımla göstermeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yakınlık, ilişki ve kadınla cinsel temas bağlamlarında kullanılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal aracısız temas ya da kişisel yürütme gerektirir; komşu dal fiili temas gerçekleşmeden yalnızca yaklaşmayı da anlatabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tenlerin değmesini geniş biçimde ve bir işe şahsen katılmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kollarla sarılma ve bedeni kucaklayarak yanında tutma eylemine özeldir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da iki bedenin doğrudan ve yakın temasını içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal için herhangi bir doğrudan ten teması yeterli olabilir; komşu dal özel olarak sarılma ve kucaklamayı gerektirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ten teması, yaklaşma ve sarılma sınırlarını en açık gösteren üç komşu yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه مباشرة المرأة بالمجامعة أو الملامسة، ومباشرة الأمر بحضوره وتوليه بنفسه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد الخبر المفرح ولا قشر الأديم ولا إطلاق البشر على الإنسان.
branches.source_phrase_ar: باشر الرجل المرأة إفضاؤه ببشرته إلى بشرتها (maqayis)؛ مباشرة الرجل المرأة لتضام أبشارهما (ayn;tahdhib)؛ مباشرة المرأة ملامستها (sihah)؛ باشر الرجل المرأة إذا ألصق بشرته ببشرتها (jamhara)؛ المباشرة الإفضاء بالبشرتين (mufradat)؛ مباشرة الأمر أن تحضره بنفسك (ayn;sihah;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi deri ya da işlenmiş deri yüzeyinin üst katmanını soyup alma işlemini, bu sırada düşen parçayı ve çekirgelerin yerin üzerindekileri yemesini açıkça bir araya getirir. Çekirge kullanımı yüzeyden giderme ortaklığıyla bağlı bir genişlemedir, çekirdek soyma işlemiyle eşitlenmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dış katmanın kendisini değil, onu soyup alma işlemini ve yalnızca belirtilen yapıda yüzeydekilerin yenmesini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Soyma anlamı hem biçimde hem deriyle kurulan yapılarda görülür; çekirgelerin yüzeydekini yemesi yalnızca kendi yapısına bağlı bir genişlemedir.

concept_map.definition: Deri ya da işlenmiş deri gibi bir yüzeyin görünen üst katmanını soyarak almayı ve bu işlemde düşen parçayı anlatır. Çekirgelerle ilgili yapıda, yerin üstündekileri yiyip tüketme anlamına genişler.

facets.statement: Deri veya benzeri bir yüzeyin görünen üst katmanı soyularak alınır.
Soyma sırasında yüzeyden düşen parça, işlemin sonucu olarak adlandırılır.
Çekirgelerle kurulan yapıda, yerin üstündekilerin yenip tüketilmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar üst deri katmanının soyularak alınmasında birleşir; ayrıca soyulan parçayı sonuç olarak ve çekirgelerin yer yüzeyindekileri yemesini yüzeyden giderme genişlemesi olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: dış katmanı soyma, soyulan parça ve yüzeydekini tüketme
concept_gloss.applicability: Soyma çekirdeğini, çıkan parçayı ve yalnızca çekirge yapısındaki yüzey tüketimini birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: İşlemi, işlemin sonucunu ve çekirge yapısına bağlı tüketme genişlemesini ayrı tutar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri ya da işlenmiş deri yüzeyinin üst bölümünün kazınıp alındığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Üst katmanın yüzeyden soyularak ayrılması işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Soyma işlemi sonunda yüzeyden ayrılıp düşen parça kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İşlem sonucunda ortaya çıkan dış katman parçasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çekirgelerin yerdeki bitki ve benzeri yüzey unsurlarını yediği özel yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çekirge yapısına bağlı yüzey tüketimini bağlam içinde tam korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Deri yüzeyini soyma sonucunu ve çekirgelerin yüzeydekini tüketmesi yapısını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Herhangi bir şeyi ve özellikle balığı derisinden ya da kabuğundan çıkarma kapsamına açılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir dış katmanı nesnenin yüzeyinden ayırma işlemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal özellikle görünen deri katmanına ve yüzeyden tüketme genişlemesine bağlıdır; komşu dal nesne ve balık üzerinden daha genel bir soyma alanına sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dış deri katmanının alınmasına ve yüzeydekilerin çekirgelerce tüketilmesine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Deriyi yüzmenin yanında dal kesme ve çubuk, yay ya da kiriş çıkarma işlemlerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir dış katmanı kazıma veya yüzerek ayırma bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yüzey derisiyle sınırlı bir soyma çekirdeği taşır; komşu dal kesme ve içinden malzeme çıkarma yönünde daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli dış katmanı soyar ve çıkan parçayı da adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi kökünden yok etmeyi, bütünüyle gidermeyi ve saç ya da yağı kaldırmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir şeyi yüzeyden kaldırma veya giderme eylemini içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal katmanla sınırlı soyma işlemidir; komşu dal tümden yok etme ve kökünü kazıma sonucuna kadar uzanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; soyma işleminin nesne kapsamı, çıkarma biçimi ve tümden giderme derecesini ayıran üç komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قشر بشرة الجلد أو الأديم، وأخذ ظاهر الجلد، وأكل الجراد ما على الأرض.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه ظهور البشرة نفسها ولا مباشرة المرأة إلا من جهة اشتراك اللفظ في البشرة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: بشرت الأديم إذا قشرت وجهه (maqayis)؛ البشر قشرك البشرة عن الجلد (ayn)؛ بشرت الأديم إذا قشرت بشرته وبشارة الأديم ما سقط منه (jamhara)؛ بشرت الأديم إذا أخذت بشرته (sihah;tahdhib)؛ بشرت الأديم أصبت بشرته وبشر الجراد الأرض إذا أكلته (mufradat)؛ بشر الجراد الأرض إذا أكل ما عليها (sihah;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çekirdeği, alıcının yüzünde sevinç uyandıran haberin verilmesi olarak kurar; haberin kendisini, haberi getireni ve alıcının sevinmesini de bu olaya bağlar. Kötü içerikli kullanım ancak içeriğin açıkça belirtilmesi veya alaycı bir tersleme bulunması koşuluyla geçerlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Niteliksiz kullanım sevindirici habere aittir; kötü haber anlamı açık bir kötü içerik ya da alaycı tersleme olmadan genellenemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal haber verme çekirdeğini biçimler ve yapılar boyunca taşır; kötü içerikli okuma yalnızca açıkça sınırlandırılmış yapıda, alaycı kullanım olarak geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Birine sevinç uyandıran bir haberi iletmeyi; buna bağlı olarak sevindirici haberi, haberi getireni ve haberi alanın sevinmesini anlatır. Kötü içerik ancak açıkça belirtilirse ya da alaycı bir tersleme kurulursa bu kalıpla bildirilebilir.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye onu sevindirecek bir haber verilir.
Sevindirici haberin kendisi ve bu haberi getiren kişi aynı haber verme olayına bağlı olarak adlandırılır.
Haberi alanın sevinmesi ve bir topluluğun karşılıklı sevindirici haber vermesi sonuç veya karşılıklılık olarak anlatılır.
Kötü içerikli bildirim yalnızca kötülük açıkça söylendiğinde veya alaycı bir tersleme yapıldığında geçerlidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, temel kullanımı sevinç veren haberin iletilmesi olarak açıklar ve haber, haberci ile alıcının sevinmesini bu çekirdeğe bağlar. Kötü içerik niteliksiz kullanıma ait değildir; açık sınırlama veya alaycı tersleme gerektirir.

concept_gloss.text: sevindirici haber verme; kötü haberde açık nitelemeli alaycı bildirim
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın olağan sevindirici haber çekirdeğini ve kötü içerik için zorunlu olan açık ya da alaycı sınırı birlikte verir.

error_profile.preserves: Haber verme olayını, sevindirici olağan kutbu ve kötü içerikteki özel koşulu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye onu sevindirecek bir olay ya da sonuç bildirildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olağan kullanımın sevindirici içerikli haber verme olayını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Verilen haberin kendisi alıcıda sevinç uyandıran içerik olarak adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Haber verme olayına bağlı sevindirici ileti içeriğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kötü sonuç açıkça söylendiğinde ve sevindirici haber kalıbı tersleyici bir alayla kullanıldığında geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Kötü içeriğin açık belirtilmesi ve alaycı tersleme koşullarını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir haber verme koşulu olmadan doğrudan sevinç ve coşku durumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin sevinmesi ve içsel ferahlık yaşamasıyla ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda sevinç bir haberin iletilmesine bağlıdır; komşu dal iletişim olayı gerektirmeyen sevinç durumunun kendisidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Olağan durumda alıcıyı sevindiren içerik ve bu içeriğe bağlı roller belirleyicidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Haberin içeriğinden bağımsız olarak açıklanmasını, yayılmasını ve başkasına iletilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir haberin bir kişiden başkasına aktarılmasını içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal haberin sevindirici etkisini merkez alır; komşu dal değer yükü olmadan haberin duyurulması ve yayılmasıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sevinci haberin verilmesi, içeriği ve haberi getiren kişi üzerinden kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ruhsal ferahlığı, sevindiren herhangi bir neden üzerinden ve karşıt sıkıntı kutbuyla anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişinin sevindirilmesi veya içinin ferahlaması sonucunu paylaşır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البشارة والبشرى والتبشير والإبشار والاستبشار والبشير، أصله الخبر السار، وقد يرد بالشر إذا قيد به أو على وجه التبكيت.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه النذارة المطلقة ولا مجرد حسن الوجه إلا من جهة أثر السرور فيه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: بشرت فلانا تبشيرا وذلك يكون بالخير وربما حمل عليه غيره من الشر (maqayis)؛ البشارة ما بشرت به والبشير المبشر بخير أو شر والبشرى الاسم (ayn;tahdhib)؛ بشرت الرجل وبشرته بما يسر به والبشرى والبشارة اسم لما بشرت به (jamhara)؛ البشارة المطلقة لا تكون إلا بالخير وإنما تكون بالشر إذا كانت مقيدة به (sihah)؛ أخبرته بسار بسط بشرة وجهه ويقال للخبر السار البشارة والبشرى (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi açık ve sevinçli yüz görünümünü çekirdeğe yerleştirir; buradan yüz güzelliğine ve genel olarak iyi görünüme uzanır. İnsan ve deve için kullanılan nitelemeler bu görünüş alanının örnekleridir; sevindirici haberin kendisi bu dala ait değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yüzün açıklığı, sevinç belirtisi ve güzel görünüşle sınırlıdır; haber verme olayı yalnızca görünüşün nedeni olabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Açık yüz ve güzellik anlamları biçimler ile belirtilen yapılara dağılır; kişi ve deve nitelemeleri kendi ad öbeklerinin sınırında tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Yüzün sevinçle açılıp sıcak ve hoş görünmesini, buradan da yüz güzelliğini ve iyi görünüşü anlatır. Güzel görünen erkek, kadın veya deve için kullanılan nitelemeler bu görünüş değerine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Yüz, sevinç belirtisiyle açık, sıcak ve güler bir görünüm kazanır.
Açık yüz görünümünden yüz güzelliği ve genel olarak güzel görünüş anlamına uzanır.
Erkek, kadın veya deve güzel ya da iyi görünüşlü olarak nitelenebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yüzün sevinç sırasında açılıp hoş görünmesinde ve bunun güzellik ile iyi görünüşe uzanmasında birleşir; kişi ve hayvan nitelemelerini bu alanın örnekleri olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sevincin yüzdeki açık görünümünü, yüz güzelliğini ve buna bağlı iyi görünüş nitelemelerini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Açık yüz çekirdeğini, güzellik uzantısını ve görünüş nitelemelerini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Yüz güzelliği ile iyi görünüş uzantısını bağlama uygun biçimde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yüzün sevinçle açılan olumlu görünümünü, komşu dal ise öfkenin yüzdeki olumsuz izini gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sevinçli yüz açıklığını kapsar ve güzel görünüşü erkek, kadın ya da hayvan için belirtebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kadının çekici tavrını, nazını ve bu tavırla birlikte değerlendirilen güzelliğini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kadının hoş görünüşünü ve güzelliğini değerlendirebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sevinçli yüz açıklığını ve genel hoş görünüşü kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yüzün dolgun, iri ve açık renkli oluşuyla tanımlanan özel bir güzellik tipidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sabahın ilk ışıklarını, hurmanın ilk olgunlaşma belirtilerini, yağmuru haber veren rüzgârları ve bir şey tamamlanmadan beliren izleri tek bir erken görünme çekirdeğinde birleştirir. Bunlar sevindirici haberin kendisi değil, yaklaşan şeyin ön belirtileridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bir şeyin erken görünen başlangıçlarını ve belirtilerini anlatır; tamamlanmış sonucu veya sırf haber verme eylemini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Erken belirti anlamı çeşitli biçim ve yapılarda gerçekleşir; sabah, hurma ve yağmur rüzgârı okumaları kendi yapılarının kapsamındadır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şey tamamlanmadan önce beliren ilk görünüm, iz veya belirtileri anlatır. Sabahın ilk ışıkları, hurmanın ilk olgunlaşma renkleri ve yağmurun yaklaştığını bildiren rüzgârlar bu erken görünmenin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir süreç veya şey tamamlanmadan önce onun ilk görünür izleri ve başlangıçları belirir.
Sabahın gecede beliren ilk ışık yolları ve başlangıç anları bu kapsamdadır.
Hurmada olgunlaşmanın ilk renkleri ve ilk olgun ürünün görünmesi erken belirti sayılır.
Yağmuru getiren rüzgârlar, yaklaşan yağışın önceden beliren işareti olarak adlandırılır.
Rüzgârın, hayvan böğrünün veya sevinçli yüzün erken görünen izleri de aynı ilk belirti düşüncesine örnektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, dalı bir şeyin ilk görünen başlangıçları ve tamamlanmadan önceki belirtileri olarak sunar; sabah ışığı, hurmanın ilk olgunluğu, yağmur rüzgârı ve çeşitli izleri bu çekirdeğe bağlar.

branches.source_phrase_ar: تباشير الصبح أوائله وكذلك أوائل كل شيء (maqayis;ayn;sihah)؛ تباشير النخل أول ما يرطب ورأى الناس التباشير في النخل إذا رأوا الحمرة والصفرة (jamhara)؛ التباشير طرائق ضوء الصبح في الليل وآثار الرياح وآثار جنب الدابة (tahdhib)؛ المبشرات الرياح التي تبشر بالغيث (maqayis;ayn;sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ تباشير الوجه وبشره ما يبدو من سروره وتباشير الصبح ما يبدو من أوائله وتباشير النخيل ما يبدو من رطبه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı belirli bir nitelemede, yumuşaklık ile sağlamlığı ve dış görünüşteki erdemlerle iç nitelikleri birleştiren tam insan olarak kurar. İşleri bilme ve her yönden tam olma da bu birleşik yetkinliğin parçasıdır; anlam çıplak biçime yayılamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca belirtilen birleşik nitelemede çok yönlü insan yetkinliğini anlatır; sırf güzellik veya genel tamamlanma yeterli değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam sabit birleşik nitelemeye bağlıdır; yumuşaklık, sağlamlık, dış ve iç erdemlerin bir aradalığı tek tek biçimlere genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir insan nitelemesinde, yumuşaklık ile sağlamlığı, dış görünüşteki erdemlerle iç nitelikleri ve işleri bilme yetisini bir araya getiren her yönlü yetkinliği anlatır.

facets.statement: Kişi tek bir üstünlükle değil, birbirini tamamlayan niteliklerin bütünüyle her yönden yetkindir.
Yumuşaklık ve sağlamlık, işleri bilme yetisiyle dengeli biçimde bir araya gelir.
Dış görünüşteki olumlu nitelikler ile iç erdemler aynı kişide birleşir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, birleşik nitelemenin her yönlü yetkin bir kişiyi anlattığında birleşir; bu yetkinliği yumuşaklıkla sağlamlığın, dışla iç erdemlerin ve uygulamalı bilginin bir aradalığıyla açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.
